headline: Two perfect starts, and eighteen days until it counts.
dek: Ouachita Baptist and Rogers State swept the opening weekend — 6–0 and 4–1 on aggregate. The table stays empty until September 17, when three matches open conference play.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Five different players have scored for Ouachita Baptist, more than for any other side in the conference.

chart.caption: Goals scored per side, all non-conference, through Aug 29.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tristan Miller has saved ten of the eleven shots on target he has faced for Rogers State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Wesley Rodriguez has two goals from four shots — a finish every second attempt.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches are marked final with no published score. Five more are past their date with no result recorded at all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match carries a result whose detail the collector could not reach: Rockhurst against Newman on August 29 has a score and no box score behind it.

findings.label: projected
findings.text: Eighteen days of tune-ups before the table means anything.

last_match.line: Southern Nazarene's only two goals of the season so far, both on the road in one afternoon.

next_match.line: The only match on the day's card.

table_state.statement: Conference play begins Sep 17. All seven sides are 0–0–0.
table_state.footnote: 3–1–0 points · early form shown from non-conference results · a pre-conference table is a valid state.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
